title: Compliance policy sets a maximum operating system version

report.title: {Items.Count} compliance {Plural(Items.Count, 'policy caps', 'policies cap')} the Windows version a device may run

messages.businessImpact: Every device that installs a Windows update past this version becomes non-compliant and loses access, so keeping machines up to date and keeping them working become opposing aims. The failure arrives silently, months after someone set the value.
messages.technicalDetail: The setting is Maximum OS version under the device properties of a Windows compliance policy. Intune does not warn when devices pass it.
remediation: Remove the maximum version unless there is a named application that genuinely breaks above it.
Where one exists, record the reason and a date to review it, and hold those devices in a group of their own rather than capping the whole estate.
messages.cannotSee: Whether a maximum was set deliberately for an application that cannot run above it. The rule reports that the cap exists, not that it is wrong, and a tenant with a good reason should suppress it in the overrides file with that reason recorded.
